name: Rhomaleopakhus
sum: Rhomaleopakhus is a mamenchisaurid sauropod from the Late Jurassic Kalaza Formation of Xinjiang, China, known from a partial forelimb.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: IVPP-V11121-1, a partial forelimb found in 1993 near Qiketai, Shanshan.
material: Known from the holotype; the material was first assigned to Hudiesaurus and separated in 2021.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Upchurch et al. 2021

images.caption: Skeletal reconstruction of Rhomaleopakhus turpanensis showing the preserved bones.
